_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: Inventory mobile scanner — server-authoritative warehouse operations (receive, transfer, pick, count). Introduces the inventory data model that the upstream inventory-stock-tracking / inventory-barcode-sku dependency specs were to deliver but which is not yet present in shillinq: InventoryItem (SKU + barcode source of truth), InventoryLocation, InventoryStock (the location-aware ledger), the operation records GoodsReceipt / InventoryTransfer / InventoryCount, and the unified MobileScanOperation batch record that carries the client-generated transactionId for idempotent offline sync (REQ-SYNC-001/002). Role-based permission gating (REQ-PERM-001), non-negative-quantity invariants, transaction idempotency and variance computation run in OCA\Shillinq\Guard\InventoryScanGuard (ADR-031 exception path) referenced from MobileScanOperation.x-openregister-lifecycle.preconditions.save. The client-side PWA offline layer (service worker, IndexedDB mirror, getUserMedia camera + jsQR/quagga decoding) is DEFERRED — see openspec/changes/inventory-mobile-scanner/tasks.md — because it is a client rewrite incompatible with the published @conduction/nextcloud-vue CnPageRenderer shell and requires a live instance to verify. Barcode capture falls back to the declarative manual-entry path (REQ-BARCODE-002). Seed data pre-loads the design.md sample locations, items and stock.

InventoryItem.title: Inventory Item
InventoryItem.description: Catalogue record for a stock-keeping unit (SKU). The single source of truth for barcode → SKU resolution (REQ-SKU-001): the barcode field is matched by the InventoryScanController resolve endpoint. Replaces the never-built inventory-barcode-sku dependency schema.

administrationId.description: Administration this item belongs to (tenant scope).

sku.description: Stock-keeping unit code, unique within an administration (REQ-SKU-001).

barcode.description: Primary EAN-13 / QR / Code-128 barcode value resolved to this SKU (REQ-SKU-001).

unitPrice.description: Unit price (EUR per ADR-000; multi-currency is future work).

InventoryLocation.title: Inventory Location
InventoryLocation.description: A warehouse storage location / bin. Multi-location support (REQ-DATA-001). Stock and operations reference a location by its code.

administrationId.description: Administration this location belongs to (tenant scope).

code.description: Short location code, unique within an administration.

organization.description: Owning organization identifier (single-organization scope per design Non-Goals).

InventoryStock.title: Inventory Stock
InventoryStock.description: Location-aware on-hand quantity for a (SKU, location) pair — the trustworthy stock ledger (REQ-DATA-001). All four warehouse operations mutate this record server-side via OCA\Shillinq\Service\InventoryScanService. Replaces the never-built inventory-stock-tracking dependency schema. lastModified drives the last-write-wins delta sync (REQ-OFFLINE-003).

administrationId.description: Administration this stock record belongs to (tenant scope).

quantity.description: Current on-hand quantity. Never negative (enforced by InventoryScanGuard).

lastModified.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the last mutation. Drives last-write-wins conflict resolution (REQ-OFFLINE-003).

item.description: The catalogue item this stock record holds.

inventoryLocation.description: The storage location this stock sits in.

GoodsReceipt.title: Goods Receipt
GoodsReceipt.description: Immutable audit record of a receive operation (REQ-INVENTORY-001). Created server-side when a warehouse_manager confirms a receive. Records the SKU, location, quantity received and the resulting on-hand quantity.

receivedBy.description: Nextcloud user id of the receiving clerk (a person is an NC entity).

transactionId.description: Idempotency key (UUID) of the originating scan operation.

InventoryTransfer.title: Inventory Transfer
InventoryTransfer.description: Immutable audit record of a transfer operation (REQ-INVENTORY-002). A single record tracks both sides of the move (source decrement + destination increment) for atomic auditing.

transferredBy.description: Nextcloud user id of the operator.

InventoryCount.title: Inventory Count
InventoryCount.description: Reconciliation record of a physical count operation (REQ-INVENTORY-004). Captures system quantity, physical quantity and the computed variance. A count is a reference point and MUST NOT auto-correct stock; the on-hand update is a separate, manually-approved scan operation.

systemQuantity.description: System on-hand quantity at count time.

countedBy.description: Nextcloud user id of the counter.

applied.description: Whether the count was applied to stock (manual approval).

MobileScanOperation.title: Mobile Scan Operation
MobileScanOperation.description: The unit of work uploaded by the mobile scanner (REQ-OFFLINE-002). One record per receive/transfer/pick/count. Carries the client-generated transactionId (UUID) for server-side idempotent deduplication (REQ-SYNC-001/002), the operation type, the acting role, and a state lifecycle (pending → applied / rejected). The save precondition (InventoryScanGuard::validateOperation) enforces role-based permission gating (REQ-PERM-001), non-negative quantities, the idempotency invariant and variance correctness before any stock mutation is persisted.

transactionId.description: Client-generated UUID (RFC 4122). Server deduplicates on this within 24h (REQ-SYNC-001).

location.description: Affected location code (source location for a transfer).

quantity.description: Operation quantity (delta received/transferred/picked, or physical count).

role.description: Role asserted client-side; re-checked server-side against the actual user role (REQ-PERM-001).

performedBy.description: Nextcloud user id that performed the operation (IDOR scope).

clientTimestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp recorded on the client when the operation was captured offline.

syncedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp the server confirmed (ACK) the operation.

rejectionReason.description: Why the operation was rejected (permission / validation), if any.

pending.label: Pending
pending.description: Captured; awaiting server validation and stock mutation.

applied.label: Applied
applied.description: Validated and applied to the stock ledger.

rejected.label: Rejected
rejected.description: Denied by a permission or validation check.

duplicate.label: Duplicate
duplicate.description: Deduplicated against a previously processed transactionId.

apply.label: Apply operation
apply.description: Apply the validated operation to the stock ledger.

reject.label: Reject operation
reject.description: Reject on a permission or validation failure.
